overview.description: The VanEck Bitcoin ETF (HODL) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the MarketVector Bitcoin Benchmark Rate index. The fund provides passive exposure to the price of Bitcoin through the purchase of shares, allowing investors to track the performance of Bitcoin without directly owning and managing the digital currency. HODL was launched on Jan 4, 2024 and is issued by VanEck.
